format: Four illustration atlases, used directly without modifying the generated artwork

prompts.mbti: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production illustration atlas for a collectible study-card game, 4 columns by 4 rows of EXACTLY 16 equal portrait panels. Canvas aspect ratio 8:11, highest available resolution. Each panel edge-to-edge, no gaps, no gutters, no borders, NO text, letters, numbers, labels, watermark. Each individual panel must remain an independent complete portrait illustration, premium collectible tarot-like contemporary gouache, luminous hand-painted fantasy editorial illustration, elegant young-adult characters, layered scenery, dramatic art direction, not chibi, not vector, no generic repeating portrait. Series: MBTI '内心宇宙', visual metaphors not clinical claims. Strict row-major subjects: row1 INTJ celestial architect woman in midnight observatory holding orbit blueprint (SSR, epic luminous star geometry); INTP inventive androgynous scholar in teal laboratory with floating crystal puzzles (SR); ENTJ commander at burgundy sky-city bridge with orbiting amber towers (SSR); ENTP playful inventor with lilac lightning and impossible chess pieces (SR). row2 INFJ quiet oracle in forest cathedral with enormous glowing moth wings (SSR); INFP dreamer rowing on moonlit ink ocean under gigantic peach paper flowers (SSR); ENFJ warm guide raising a gold lantern over community of cloud houses (SR); ENFP joyful explorer leaping through coral floating islands and wind ribbons (SR). row3 ISTJ meticulous archivist in indigo infinite library (SR); ISFJ gardener sheltering tiny illuminated glass greenhouse in snow (SR); ESTJ navigator at bronze astronomical clockwork port (SR); ESFJ host of warm terracotta rooftop lantern feast (SR). row4 ISTP mechanic girl riding a sapphire mechanical koi through city canals (SR); ISFP painter whose brush makes a giant iridescent living peacock (SSR); ESTP aerial skater above vermilion neon rooftops with comet trail (SR); ESFP dancer under disco moon and raining rose-gold stars (SSR). Use distinct palettes, dynamic silhouettes and each setting unlike the others. Rich beautiful scenes, magical over ordinary. No card frames, UI or lettering.
